notes:
Bug Fixes

- More reliable DNS after network changes and when local port 53 is in use, such as by Personal Hotspot.
- macOS: The menu bar now opens the correct copy of the app.

Features

- Apple TV: A new lightweight tvOS client. Share your configuration between devices via iCloud or the local network.
- IP-CIDR rule files now refresh silently in the background.
- Activity shows local DNS results alongside Fake-IP.

Performance Improvements

- Less redundant DNS and connection pool work, and a cap on diagnostic history.

Bug Fixes

- More reliable DNS after network switches, sleep and outages, including IPv6 DNS servers.
- Temporarily skip failing DNS servers instead of sticking to one.

Features

- Export application logs to make connection issues easier to diagnose.

Bug Fixes

- Improve DNS resolution and failover on hotspot connections, network changes, unavailable local DNS ports, and intercepting resolvers

Performance Improvements

- Reduce DNS CPU wakeups, memory copies, and lock contention with one-shot timers and transaction-ID dispatch
- Reduce background UI polling, redraws, and log writes to lower idle energy use

Bug Fixes

- Demote expected DNS remote-send errors to debug
- Graceful shutdown may be compromised
- Harden DNSRecorder caching and isolate unit tests
- Preserve completion for empty stream sends
- Reduce SwiftUI/shared-notification UI retain noise
- resolve Core Data UI refresh issues by enabling automaticallyMergesChangesFromParent and forcing refetch refresh
- Stabilize ConnectionRecorder counters and sampling
- Startup error with no logs

Performance Improvements

- Allow timer margin to reduce battery consumption

Bug Fixes

- Connection dispatch frame error when switching to the next stream

- The initial DNS record is not working

- Optimize network connectivity and encoder stability and efficiency
